General Manager Job at LEAM Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        LEAM Consulting Limited is the foremost consulting firm that stands out in areas of professional certification training, HR advisory services, Business Development / Startup, and IT consulting services in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: General Manager

Job Location: Fate - Ilorin, Kwara
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced, hands-on,result driven Restaurant General Manager to take full ownership of our daily restaurant operations, drive revenue and maintain high service standard for our branches.


Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Manage staff, assign responsibilities and monitor employee performance to ensure seamless service delivery and work flow
	Monitor daily/weekly/monthly sales target,manage labor cost ,control food wastage/inventory and analyse financial performance with each department in charge
	Coordinate with kitchen, service and other departments to ensure effective operations.
	Develop strategies, Coordinate promotional activities, cooporate bookings,and special event to expand the restaurant revenue streams


Requirements


	HND/ B.Sc in Hospitality management, Business Administration or a related field.
	4-5 years of relevant experience in a senior role, management, preferably in the fast-food, restaurant or hospitality industry.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in administration, Human Resource Management and people operations.
	Exceptional leadership,problem solving and interpersonal communication skill.
	Ability to work independently without supervision with high attention to detail and proactive management style.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For more information Whatsapp: 09047710414.
